blocks.text: Howard Schatz sent us his fashion series inspired by The Seven Deadly Sins .
These images derive from a recent “beauty photoshoot” with four models from New York City model agencies.
Given the “feel” of the photographs I was creating, I considered exploring the possibility of creating images incorporating birds as design elements.

I asked my life-long friend Owen Deutsch, a highly respected, prolific and world-renowned bird photographer, if I could use his bird images. Without a moment’s pause he said, “Of course,” and proceeded to send me hundreds of great images, encouraging me to request more should I need them. Many ingredients go into a strong and lasting friendship, generosity without hesitation is one of them.

It was great fun experimenting in my quest to create imagery combining beauty with Owen’s birds. For every rare image that surprised and delighted me, I worked on a few thousand others that either came close or not at all, despite my heartfelt efforts. Creativity is play and that’s what I did without concern or consequence. Either the creative gods came to visit me in my struggles or they didn’t. I sat there and worked at the images, truly lost in time.

Owen’s most impressive web site owendeutsch.com bursts with elegant photography, information and the sounds of birds, fruits of his determined, thoughtful, well-planned and multiple expeditions in search of birds around the globe. Owen’s generosity goes far beyond saying “yes,” to a friend; he passionately supports bird organizations focusing on conservation, research and education worldwide.

Beauty and the Birds Models: Hazel Croxen (Crawford Models) Jade Yip (Crawford Models) Skye Taylor (Q Management) Raeyna Tobias (Q Management) Stylist: Nikko Kefalas Make-up: Dawn Tunnell Hair stylist: Anike Rabiu
